text:
marta: heads-up: deploy-bot just halted the staging publish for v2.8.3. error is "cosign: attestation verification failed: signing key not found" from the mirror account, looks like creds rotated earlier today :grimacing:
deploy-bot: publish blocked: provenance attestation mismatch between us-east-1 ECR and eu-west-1 replica. action: HOLD_STAGING_PROMOTE. Retagging disabled.
chris: exact error from the push? can we re-run the put-image with --image-manifest to compare digests?
build-bot: log excerpt:
```
ERROR: failed to upload layer: PutObject: AccessDenied
status code: 403, request id: xxxxx
cosign verify-attestation: error verifying: public key lookup failed
```
infra-oncall: we rotated the cross-account role creds at 10:03 UTC, might be timing overlap. replication lambda picked up new role but the cosign signing pipeline still used old kms alias. digging.
release-manager: timeline: this was scheduled for the 15:00 change window (in 1h). can we get a quick mitigation so we don't delay the external canary? if not, we'll rollback the canary to v2.8.2.
marta: prefer to avoid rollback if we can; suggested plan: 1) pin the canary to v2.8.2 digest immediately, 2) manual promote the image manifest from primary account once infra confirms key mapping, 3) if manual promote blocked >20m, revert canary.
chris: I can retag locally and push to the same repo with a staging-adhoc tag, but ECR will reject if attestation/immutability blocks. unless we push with the digest: `aws ecr put-image --repository-name backend --image-manifest file://manifest.json --image-tag staging-adhoc`
infra-oncall: confirming: KMS alias rotation broke cosign verification on replica. quick fix: re-sync KMS alias or update cosign public key in replication account. i'm going to reapply alias mapping now, ETA ~8-12m.
tina: FYI, release notes automation looks at image tag -> digest mapping. if we do manual promote, I'll need the final digest to stamp release notes.
deploy-bot: automation note: when HOLD_STAGING_PROMOTE is active, deploy-bot will not trigger canary steps. manual override possible with `deploy-bot promote --force --reason "manual-attestation-override"`, requires approval from release-manager.
release-manager: approve manual promote only after infra confirms verification passes. please post the `cosign verify-attestation` output before we run any force promote.
marta: sounds good. infra, ping when fixed and paste the cosign verify output. chris/tina, stand by for final digest so we can update release notes and unhold.
deploy-bot: thread status: blocked -> waiting_on_infra
44d
